title: Cancelling an order leaves the books unbalanced; the cause spans three modules
spec:
OBJECTIVE
After an order is cancelled, the shop's books no longer balance and stock counts drift. Reproduce with the visible test, find every cause, and fix them so the invariants hold: reserved stock is fully released on cancel, the ledger reverses exactly what was posted, and the reconciliation report is zero for every cancelled order. Do not special-case the tests.

FILES
src/shop/ (any module in the package). Do not modify tests/.

INTERFACES
Keep every public function signature in src/shop/*.py unchanged.
shop.orders.cancel(order_id) must leave: inventory.available(sku) equal to its value before the order was placed; ledger.balance('receivable') and ledger.balance('revenue') equal to their values before the order; reconcile.report(order_id) == {'stock_delta': 0, 'ledger_delta': 0}.

CONSTRAINTS
The defect is not in one place. Read the whole package before editing. Python stdlib only.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

REASONING
as invoked
